main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a single manga page. Carries the facet/embed source fields consumed by the derive rule `page-published-social` in kotodama.jsonld to auto-emit a thread-reply app.bsky.feed.post. The page image is carried as app.bsky.embed.recordWithMedia (record = strongRef to self; media = embed.images with compositedImageCid); charactersAppearing[] becomes facet#mention entries; the chapterRef is resolved via the derive engine's {{derived(record.chapterRef).strongRef}} expression to set reply.root / reply.parent for thread continuity.

chapterRef.description: strongRef to com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.chapter. Resolved by derive engine to set reply.root/parent on the derived post (threaded after the chapter-published post).

compositedImageCid.description: Blob CID of the composited full-page image (layers flattened, uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob). Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image. Target dimensions: portrait PNG, W=1080 H≈1920 for mobile-comfortable reading.

altText.description: Alt text for the page image (a11y). Recommended to include speaker-attributed dialogue + panel-order summary.

width.description: Pixel width of compositedImageCid. Used for embed.images[].aspectRatio.width.

height.description: Pixel height of compositedImageCid. Used for embed.images[].aspectRatio.height.

panels.description: Per-panel geometry + dialogue. Not exposed in the derived post directly; used by the full-screen reader (mangaka.etzhayyim.com/at/...) for panel-level navigation, and by yabai-style LLM downstream workers for per-panel analysis.

charactersAppearing.description: Characters appearing on this page (subset of chapter.charactersAppearing). Derive rule expands each into app.bsky.richtext.facet#mention with did = did:web:mangaka.etzhayyim.com:character:{slug}. Keep the list tight (page-scope) to avoid mention spam in the thread reply.

layersCid.description: Blob CID of the KAMI Engine native layered document (ink / tone / color / sketch). Consumed by the full-screen reader for editable load; not used by the derived social post.

panel.description: Inline panel geometry within a page. Mirrors com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.panel record fields for embedded read models; panel records may still be created separately if per-panel federated addressing is needed.

x.description: Top-left x in normalized [0,1] page coordinates.

y.description: Top-left y in normalized [0,1] page coordinates.

w.description: Panel width in normalized [0,1] page coordinates.

h.description: Panel height in normalized [0,1] page coordinates.

order.description: Read order within the page (1-indexed, right-to-left JP convention honored by reader).

speakers.description: Character slugs speaking in this panel (subset of page.charactersAppearing). Used by alt-text generator + per-panel LLM analysis.

contentCid.description: Optional blob CID of the panel-only cropped image (for per-panel federated sharing).
